name: bloodthirsty_conqueror_and_blight_priest_drain_loop
notes: M4 mapper probe of a printed two-card loop. Bloodthirsty Conqueror ('Whenever an opponent loses life, you gain that much life.') with FDN Marauding Blight-Priest ('Whenever you gain life, each opponent loses 1 life.'). Seat 1's Bear dies with FDN Massacre Wurm out: seat 1 loses 2, seat 0 gains 2, then every gain makes seat 1 lose 1 and every loss gains seat 0 1, until seat 1 has no life left and loses the game (CR 704.5a).
